note: Everything needed to reproduce the shipped core binary. Nothing here points at a checkout outside this repository: a fresh clone plus Docker is the whole toolchain. `make core` refuses to package an artifact whose sha256 does not match, so this file is the contract between the build and the pak.

source.note: One commit feeds both shipped FreeJ2ME-Plus binaries: this libretro core and the jar in runtime/runtime.lock.json. The pipe protocol between them is unversioned, so they are never built from different revisions.

patch.note: Runs the jar and Java runtime bundled beside the core by absolute path, ties the JVM's life to the frontend with PR_SET_PDEATHSIG, exits the forked child when exec fails, fails retro_load_game() when the JVM is not running, and drops the system-directory firmware entry from the .info file. It also sets this build's defaults for a one-stick Nintendo-style handheld: Fire on A (9 on Y), LCD backlight off, 2 MIDI synthesizers, a Pointer Stick option that lets the left stick move the pointer, and a pointer tip that stays on the canvas.

toolchain.note: Public image, pullable anonymously. The digest is what the build uses; a tag can move under you and a moved toolchain changes the binary.

artifact.note: Recorded from clean builds in the digest-pinned image on 2026-10-18 (a FORCE=1 rebuild and a build from a fresh clone in a separate build directory agree). CI is the independent verifier; investigate any mismatch rather than overwriting these values.
